metadata.title: Boundary flexibility for curvature conditions
metadata.abstract: We prove a general boundary gluing principle for families of Riemannian metrics with pointwise curvature restrictions on manifolds with possibly non-compact boundary. This includes, as special cases, the classical gluing theorems by Perelman for metrics with positive Ricci curvature and convex singularities and by Gromov-Lawson and Bär-Hanke for metrics with positive scalar curvature and mean convex singularities. Using the language of algebraic curvature cones, our theorem implies and unifies many more previous gluing results. We also prove a boundary deformation principle that enables us to compare spaces of metrics with interior curvature restrictions and different boundary conditions. Our construction is based on the local flexibility lemma for open partial differential relations, as well as explicit 1-jet deformations of metrics along the boundary.

analysis.workSummary: 建立适用于带边界度量族的通用粘合和变形机制，在包括非紧边界的设置中保持逐点曲率条件。
techniques: 局部柔性与开放 PDE 关系
analysis.breakthrough: 统一正 Ricci 与正标量曲率的若干经典粘合方法，并比较不同边界条件下的度量空间。
analysis.limitations: 并非任意曲率条件都可粘合；曲率锥及边界相容性需核查，参数化结论也有其前提。仅依据官方英文摘要及作者评论，尚未核查正文与完整证明；技术说明仅限摘要明确的信息，关键结论需回查原文。未见 AI 协作声明仅指这些已检查来源，不代表已核验整篇论文完全由人类完成。
analysis.priorityReason: 曲率保持构造的统一工具高度可复用，是本期优先阅读的方法工作。
